author: Tirnanog
text:
GGJJ wrote: Hi Edge, V and IF,

Here is my thought on this topic.

Regarding RTM promoting, one of the ideas which will attract more people
 I think is to show them where to put the entry/SL before price reaches
there. People would be able to make some real money without any analysis
 or thinking, just copying IF or (masters)'s trades. MPL trades would be
 the best candidate. Tiny SL, little risk.

I said SOME money, no need to show trade opportunities over again and
again. Just enough trades to make people believe RTM can help them make
some real money.

I clearly knew this is very challenging for IF or masters or the people
who predicts the price(maybe I am wrong, it is easy for IF or masters ).
 What if the prediction is wrong? I do not think being wrong sometimes
is not a big deal (as we all know). The idea is to make profits overall
(10-20 trades within a few months let’s say). One of the keys we show
here is to be honest to people. (Do not get me wrong, we are not
honest now). The aim is to make people believe.

If people made some real money, they would believe RTM is the way for them. If they want to learn more, they have to join it.

We have already posted trades RTM members took weekly. This method is
less effective and cannot convince people. Why? 1. Anyone can mark such
 a chart for the past. 2. Even people believe that trade is genuine,
that could be one of them in 100 trades for example.

Another idea is to predict price again, but have a voting system to show
 how many RTM members support this prediction. I believe more people
support a prediction, less likely the trade would go wrong. There are a
lot to play in this area. Basically getting people involved.

I remember there was an idea before called “daily opportunities”. Many
people would be interested in this section if we have one in forum.

I am not encouraging laziness, people do not do their own study/hardwork
 and just copy other people’s ideas. There are a lot of details which
need to be thought about how to make it working.

I am sure there are other considerations I have missed. Any comments are welcome! Brainstorming!

Hi GGJJ,

Nice plan, would be very effective. Would also be disappointing to see
this ignored but would be very encouraging for many people to see this
in action.

author: bobyv87
text:
Its very difficult, if not impossible to give signals using RTM
reading way. Why? Because even the right level can be FOed. So, knowing
that, we always should have hard stops somewhere, but we don't wait for
the hard stop to be hit, instead, after price break our level (fail
level), we exit right at the next chance, when price bounce back to our
fail level so we can exit without loss. Now, imagine that every level
could have inside a few fresh orders. Would you wait always for MPLs
inside each levels? If yes, you will miss a lot of opportunities. Would
you wait lower than MPL? Maybe you wouldn't have the chance to exit at
BE if your level fails. So, you have to take quick decisions, even if
you have a good level and a good signal. At the same LSK IF can take a
BE or a small profit, but in the same time others can take losses.
Because of these multiple factors, its very difficult to do that. And
imagine how much pressure you can put on IF with that. However, i'm
planning to create a group of traders soon on the whatsapp, formed with
those who can participate at meetings daily and share our setups for
the day together so we can all benefit of our setups. :)

author: Tirnanog
text:
Edge wrote: Its always good to
spark discussion. But please dont think anything has been "ignored" Not

countless ideas have been considered by IF. As some of you know, he is
one of my closest friends and that is why I am comfortable in saying

Edge I understand and maybe a better word than ignored should have been selected.

This all began because of a guy who posted his trades in advance showing
 trade after trade all before the fact and all containing a lesson.

Where the viewing traders decided to only use the "signal" they are likely not trading today but that clearly was not a concern.

Win or lose his confidence in his method left him comfortable to show
all trades leaving traders to take a lesson or take a signal.

A lot of people could have viewed the work as a "signal" service but can
 anyone here say that's true when we can see what this method of
teaching transpired into.

The lessons in the winning or losing trades are equal and with the RR we
 see here the scales would surely be tipped in the traders favour.

This isn't a course of action that requires the worlds view but the view
 of all RTM traders who can then share their verified accounts

With the benefit of both the students and RTM the positives with this
type of plan exceed the negatives by so much that it would be
unnecessary to even list them here.

As stated by Edge "Its always good to spark a discussion" and hopefully
this discussion will lead to a new building block for both RTM and its
students.

bobyv while I can't agree with everything you stated I appreciate that
your heading in the right direction and if you need a hand just let me
know.
